messages:
support-ian: Customer AcmeAI reporting intermittent 429s and big p99 token latency after a 30s burst (~500 rps). They call it throttling but tenant quotas look ok. Any ideas?

alex: can you paste a sample request + headers and the tenant id? also timeline from dashboards?

support-ian: tenant: t-acme-01
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":256}'

Logs:
[2026-03-16T14:02:10Z] request=xyz tenant=t-acme-01 batch_delay_ms=120 result=429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED
[2026-03-16T14:02:12Z] request=abc tenant=t-acme-01 kv_prefetch=miss

maria: :thinking: this looks like KV-prefetch + continuous batching feedback. New prefixes -> cache misses -> prefetch stalls batch assembly -> batch_delay increases -> client retries -> tighter feedback -> perceived throttling. Not classic quota 429s but head-of-line/backpressure.

olivia: how to repro locally quickly?

alex: run a short script that fires ~400 rps with unique prefixes. example:
for i in {1..400}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"u'$i'","max_tokens":64}' & done

maria: mitigation options:
- temp disable kv_prefetch for tenant
- lower max_batch_delay_ms (e.g., 8-16ms) to avoid large waits
- enable early_send_on_kv_hit so batches don't wait on misses
- increase tenant concurrency/backfill limit briefly
- client-side: add jittered exponential backoff on 429s, avoid tight sync retries

maria: admin patch (internal):
PATCH /v1/admin/tenants/t-acme-01/config
{ "kv_prefetch": {"enabled": false}, "batching": {"max_batch_delay_ms": 8, "early_send_on_kv_hit": true} }

alex: quick checks: kubectl logs -n prod runtime | grep "t-acme-01" | tail -n 30
or query metrics: /dashboards/tenant_latency?t=t-acme-01

eng-jordan: :thumbsup: good plan. if disabling prefetch helps we can follow up with a prefetch rate limiter and staggered warmup for new prefixes.

support-ian: I'll apply the patch to t-acme-01 now and monitor. will report back in ~5m.

deploy-bot: Patch applied to t-acme-01 by support-ian (deploy-1234) :rocket:

support-ian: initial results: p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 220ms, 429s stopped. keeping disabled while eng implements staged prefetch.

olivia: can we add a short note for runbook? i'll draft.

support-ian: thanks all :heart:
